a.description: A tensor of shape `(..., M, M)` representing the coefficients matrix.

b.description: A tensor of shape `(..., M)` or `(..., M, N)` representing the right-hand side or "dependent variable" matrix.

output.description: A tensor of shape `(..., M)` or `(..., M, N)` representing the solution of the linear system. Returned shape is identical to `b`.
